svg.title: One tools/call request and the result it produced, field by field
svg.desc: Two panels of equal size joined by a short arrow. The left panel is a tools slash call request with four labelled fields on stacked rows: method, name, arguments, and the per-request metadata object holding the protocol version, the client capabilities and the client info. A footnote expands the abbreviated key prefix as io dot modelcontextprotocol slash, and notes say every argument must satisfy the declared input schema and that a Resolve parameter never appears in it. The right panel is the result, with four fields on the same four rows: resultType complete, an array of content blocks, structuredContent carrying the same answer as machine-readable JSON, and isError, which is false here. Notes say the text block repeats the same JSON and that the client validates the structured data against the declared output schema, so missing or non-conforming data fails on the client rather than the server. A band across the bottom records what is absent: no earlier message, no handshake, no session identifier, and nothing carried over from a previous call.
svg.text: One request, one result, and the two fields each side cannot leave out.
name and _meta are required. arguments may be left out.
Every argument must satisfy the declared inputSchema.
A Resolve parameter never appears here at all.
content is required. isError defaults to false.
The text block repeats the same JSON.
The client validates it against the declared outputSchema.
Missing or non-conforming data fails on the client.
There is no earlier message in this exchange.
No handshake, no session identifier, nothing carried over from a previous call.
